description.zh:
监播室ID。
>通过查看[CreateLiveStreamMonitor](~~2848129~~)接口的返回参数获取MonitorId值。
description.en:
The ID of the monitoring session.

> Obtain the MonitorId value from the response of the [CreateLiveStreamMonitor](~~2848129~~) operation.

descriptions.zh:
先通过[CreateLiveStreamMonitor](~~2848129~~)创建监播室，由接口返回参数获取**MonitorId**后开启监播。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
You can call the [CreateLiveStreamMonitor](~~2848129~~) operation to create a monitoring session. Then, you can use the **MonitorId** value from the response to start the session.

## QPS limits

The queries per second (QPS) limit for this operation is 10 calls per second for each user. Calls that exceed this limit are throttled. Throttling may affect your business. Plan your calls accordingly.
